title: Use after free in Microsoft Edge for iOS allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network (CVE-2026-96192)
description: A use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge for iOS allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code remotely over a network. This vulnerability could lead to complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The issue is identified as CVE-2026-96192 and has a high severity score of 8.8.
